# The command catalog

Every command of the command line: its own words and forms, the 10 packs' codes, and the 93 mnemonics the packs define, each with what it does and an example. A pack's mnemonics work when the pack is switched on ([PACKS.md](PACKS.md)); how to type them is in [USER_GUIDE.md](USER_GUIDE.md).

**Data** says what kind of data a command shows ([the data contracts](../contracts/README.md#3-four-kinds-of-data)): *fundamental* (masters, terms, market and public data, kept as delivered), *engine input* (what upstream engines deliver for the computed measures), *Drishti's own* (made by Drishti) and *computed* (worked out when asked). **Change** says when a command moves to the compute model, or when the figures on a record start to be computed instead of stored ([the roadmap](../architecture/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md#the-computed-measures-roadmap-280-to-2120-product-owner-2026-10-25)). Each mnemonic's fields are in its data contract ([every command's contract](../contracts/packs/README.md)).

In numbers: 74 fundamental, 8 engine input, 1 Drishti's own and 10 computed; 0 move to the compute model and 0 keep their record while its figures become computed.

## The command line's own forms

| Form | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `<MNEMONIC> <id>` | `TRD 1000015` | Opens one entity, the kind the mnemonic names, as its page. |
| `<MNEMONIC> <id> <range>` | `TRD 1000015 30` | The entity over time: the last N business days (30), a span (3M, 2W, 1Y, YTD, MTD, QTD) or FROM date TO date; DIFF shows only what changed. |
| `<MNEMONIC> <field>=<value> …` | `TRD desk=rates` | Searches the kind; a prefix (TRD MX-2*) gives a pick list. |
| `<PACK CODE>` | `MKT` | Opens the pack's overview, what it holds and its commands. |
| `<alias>` | `MYBOOK` | A word a user saved on My account → Aliases for a longer command; words after it are kept (MYBOOK 30). |
| `<plain words>` | `live trades over 5m` | Anything that is not a command but reads as words is offered as a question. |

## Reserved words

No pack may define a mnemonic with these names; they work in any case.

| Word | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `BI` | `BI CATALOGUE` | The BI home. After it: WORKSPACE(S), CATALOGUE (CATALOG), RUNS (RUN), SETTINGS, or a report or board by name. |
| `RUPAKA` | `RUPAKA` | The older name of BI; everything that works after BI works after it. |
| `FORM` | `FORM trading trade` | The forms home; FORM <pack> opens the pack's search form, FORM <pack> <kind> its form for that kind. |
| `VAR` | `VAR DESK DESK-RATES` | The VaR explorer. After it: BANK, LE, DIV, DESK, BOOK, NODE, POS, TRD (TRADE), PORT (PORTFOLIO), BASKET, WHERE, SCOPE (a saved basket, a portfolio or scope text) or CAPTURE <id>. |

## Pack codes

A pack's code typed alone opens the pack's overview.

| Code | Pack | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `CMPD` | `compute-demo` | Sample pack for reactive connectors: three books of synthetic P&L strips (250 scenario days each) and the sum of a book's paths computed when it is asked for, by a Python engine in a compute pool (path-sum) and by its Java twin in the server (path-sum-java), with progress on the screen and a state per panel. Synthetic numbers only. Not loaded unless named in DRISHTI_PACKS. |
| `CORE` | `core` | The parties and organisation every pack builds on: counterparties (with country of risk and UEN), groups, issuers, CCPs, legal entities, books and portfolios, desks, traders and holiday calendars. |
| `CCR` | `counterparty-risk` | ISDA master agreements and CSAs, netting sets, exposure and PFE, CVA/XVA, SA-CCR, credit limits, collateral, margin calls and SIMM. |
| `GLEIF` | `gleif` | Legal Entity Identifiers from GLEIF (CC0): the legal entities of the us-equities companies' ownership groups and of the large banks (the FSB's G-SIBs and others), insurers, asset managers and market infrastructures, with their parents and children, addresses, registration and renewal, BICs and ISINs. Off by default; with us-equities on, a company and its LEI record link both ways. |
| `MKT` | `market-data` | Curves, volatility surfaces, FX, equities, credit, inflation, commodities, fixings and bonds. |
| `MRSK` | `market-risk` | Value at risk, stress testing, FRTB sensitivities and P&L explain. |
| `NWMK` | `news-and-markets` | Sample pack: fifteen news topics (central banks, countries, companies, themes) and twenty listed companies, with headlines (Google News) and quotes and price history (Yahoo Finance) fetched on demand. Internal demonstration only: Yahoo's endpoint is unofficial and its terms restrict use; names leave the network when the connectors are on. Off until the connectors are enabled; offline (DRISHTI_OFFLINE=true, or the connectors off) the demo lake serves a captured snapshot of the same quotes and headlines. |
| `TRDS` | `trading` | Trades in 125 products across rates, FX, credit, equity, commodities, inflation, fixed income, securities financing, money markets and structured products. |
| `USEQS` | `us-equities` | Public data on the companies of the Dow 30, the Nasdaq-100 and the S&P 500, and on major US, Canadian and UK banks that file with the SEC: SEC EDGAR companies, SIC sectors, filings and ten years of annual XBRL financials, LEIs from GLEIF and index membership from Wikidata. Prices are not shipped: the price-history kind is read live by a connector that is off by default and for internal use only. |
| `WRLD` | `world-economy` | Real public economic data for about 200 economies: output, growth, prices, jobs, debt and external balance (World Bank, IMF, CIA World Factbook), IMF forecasts, and World Bank regions and income groups; and governments and societies: government type, office holders, elections, parties with seats, and social and governance indicators (CIA World Factbook, World Bank, UNDP). |

## Compute demo (`compute-demo`)

Sample pack for reactive connectors: three books of synthetic P&L strips (250 scenario days each) and the sum of a book's paths computed when it is asked for, by a Python engine in a compute pool (path-sum) and by its Java twin in the server (path-sum-java), with progress on the screen and a state per panel. Synthetic numbers only. Not loaded unless named in DRISHTI_PACKS.

| Command | Opens | What it does | Example | Data | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PBOOK` | Path book | A book of synthetic P&L strips, and the sum of their paths computed when the page asks: by a Python engine and by its Java twin. | `PBOOK BOOK-RATES` | engine input |  |
| `PSTRIP` | P&L strip | P&L strip (the path-strip kind of the compute-demo pack) | `PSTRIP STRIP-FX-001` | engine input |  |
| `PSUM` | Book path (Python) | Book path (Python) (the path-sum kind of the compute-demo pack) |  | computed |  |
| `PSUMJ` | Book path (Java) | Book path (Java) (the path-sum-java kind of the compute-demo pack) | `PSUMJ BOOK-FX` | computed |  |

## Core (`core`)

The parties and organisation every pack builds on: counterparties (with country of risk and UEN), groups, issuers, CCPs, legal entities, books and portfolios, desks, traders and holiday calendars.

| Command | Opens | What it does | Example | Data | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CPTY` | Counterparty | A legal entity the bank trades with: identifiers (LEI, UEN), rating, sector, country of risk and parent group. | `CPTY CP-NORTHBRIDGE` | fundamental |  |
| `GRP` | Counterparty group | Economic group of related counterparties (obligor group). | `GRP GRP-ALDERSHOT` | fundamental |  |
| `ISS` | Issuer | Issuer of bonds and reference entity for CDS. | `ISS ISS-BUND` | fundamental |  |
| `CCP` | Central counterparty | A clearing house with its default fund and margin model. | `CCP CCP-CME` | fundamental |  |
| `LE` | Bank legal entity | The bank's own booking entity. | `LE LE-NY` | fundamental |  |
| `BOOK` | Book | A trading book: owner desk, trades and risk. | `BOOK BOOK-RATES-1` | fundamental |  |
| `DESK` | Desk | A trading desk: books, limits and risk results. | `DESK DESK-RATES` | fundamental |  |
| `TRDR` | Trader | A trader and their books. | `TRDR TRDR-ASHAH` | fundamental |  |
| `CAL` | Holiday calendar | Business-day calendar (USNY, TARGET, GBLO, JPTO…). | `CAL CAL-EUTA` | fundamental |  |
| `CLR` | Clearing account | An account at a CCP holding cleared trades and margin. | `CLR CLR-CME-1` | fundamental |  |

## Counterparty credit risk (`counterparty-risk`)

ISDA master agreements and CSAs, netting sets, exposure and PFE, CVA/XVA, SA-CCR, credit limits, collateral, margin calls and SIMM.

| Command | Opens | What it does | Example | Data | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AGR` | Master agreement | ISDA, GMRA or GMSLA master agreement with its key elections. | `AGR AGR-NORTHBRIDGE-ISDA` | fundamental |  |
| `CSA` | Credit support annex | Collateral terms: thresholds, minimum transfer, eligible collateral and haircuts. | `CSA CSA-ALDERSHOT` | fundamental |  |
| `NSET` | Netting set | Trades that net on close-out under one agreement and CSA, with exposure and collateral. | `NSET NS-ALDERSHOT-NY` | fundamental |  |
| `LIM` | Credit limit | PFE limit by tenor bucket for a counterparty, with utilisation. | `LIM LIM-SUMMIT` | fundamental |  |
| `CVA` | CVA / XVA | Credit, debit and funding valuation adjustments with sensitivities. | `CVA CVA-SUMMIT-NY` | fundamental |  |
| `SACCR` | SA-CCR exposure | Regulatory EAD: replacement cost, PFE add-ons by asset class, multiplier. | `SACCR SACCR-SUMMIT-NY` | fundamental |  |
| `COLL` | Collateral balance | Collateral held and posted under a CSA, by asset, after haircuts. | `COLL COLL-ALDERSHOT-FRA` | fundamental |  |
| `MC` | Margin call | A variation or initial margin call and its settlement status. | `MC MC-ALDERSHOT-FRA-1` | fundamental |  |
| `SIMM` | ISDA SIMM initial margin | Initial margin by risk class and product class. | `SIMM SIMM-ALDERSHOT` | fundamental |  |
| `XRUN` | Exposure simulation run | An upstream exposure simulation of a business date: its paths, its grid of future dates (primary and look-back), its model and seed; the exposure engine reads it beside the paths (EXP.md section 3.2). | `XRUN XR-2026-09-30-01` | engine input |  |
| `XPATH` | Exposure path (a trade's MtM on every path at a grid date) | One trade's mark to market on every path of a simulation run at one grid date, in USD (the vector column MTM); the grain every exposure is netted, collateralised and counted from (EXP.md section 3.3). | `XPATH XR-2026-09-30-01~CLY-3000280~0` | engine input |  |
| `EXP` | Exposure profile of a scope (computed) | The exposure profile (EE, ENE, EEE, PFE at 95% and 99%, EE without collateral) and the figures (CE, EPE, EEPE, peak EE and PFE, EAD under the internal model) of any counterparty scope (the scope grammar of EXP.md section 8), computed when asked by the server's exposure engine from the simulated paths, as the person asking; never stored. | `EXP NSET:NS-ALDERSHOT-FRA` | computed |  |
| `XWIF` | Exposure what-if before dealing (computed, Python) | A scope's exposure before and after candidate trades kept in the person's private sandbox, by the exact paths method (each candidate's values on every path of the day's run added to its netting set, collateral and exposure computed again), computed when asked by the Python exposure engine from the scope's exposure-result; never stored. |  | computed |  |

## GLEIF legal entities (`gleif`)

Legal Entity Identifiers from GLEIF (CC0): the legal entities of the us-equities companies' ownership groups and of the large banks (the FSB's G-SIBs and others), insurers, asset managers and market infrastructures, with their parents and children, addresses, registration and renewal, BICs and ISINs. Off by default; with us-equities on, a company and its LEI record link both ways.

| Command | Opens | What it does | Example | Data | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LEI` | LEI legal entity | A legal entity from its LEI record: key facts, addresses, registration and renewal, parents, children and identifiers. | `LEI 8I5DZWZKVSZI1NUHU748` | fundamental |  |
| `LEIG` | LEI ownership group | An ownership group: the ultimate parent with its whole tree, every member, and counts by country and legal form. | `LEIG 8I5DZWZKVSZI1NUHU748` | fundamental |  |
| `LEIR` | LEI parent relationship | One consolidation relationship from GLEIF's level 2 data: the child, its direct or ultimate parent, status and periods. | `LEIR LEIREL-010PWNH4K3BLIC3I7R03-DIRECT` | fundamental |  |
| `LEIC` | LEI country | A country's legal entities in the pack: the entities, the groups present, legal forms and cities. | `LEIC GB` | fundamental |  |
| `LEIM` | ISIN or BIC to LEI | An ISIN, BIC or MIC and the legal entity GLEIF's mapping files give it. | `LEIM WABTUS3WXXX` | fundamental |  |

Curves, volatility surfaces, FX, equities, credit, inflation, commodities, fixings and bonds.

| Command | Opens | What it does | Example | Data | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `FX` | FX spot rate | Spot rate for a currency pair with bid/ask. | `FX FX-AUDUSD` | fundamental |  |
| `FXF` | FX forward curve | Forward points by tenor for a pair. | `FXF FXF-AUDUSD` | fundamental |  |
| `FXV` | FX volatility surface | Implied vols by expiry and delta (ATM, 25D RR/BF). | `FXV FXV-EURUSD` | fundamental |  |
| `IRV` | Swaption volatility cube | Normal (bp) swaption vols by expiry × tenor. | `IRV IRV-AUD` | fundamental |  |
| `CPV` | Cap/floor volatility surface | Cap vols by maturity and strike. | `CPV CPV-AUD` | fundamental |  |
| `EQ` | Equity | A listed stock: price, dividends, sector and identifiers. | `EQ EQ-NVTK` | fundamental |  |
| `EQX` | Equity index | Index level with its largest constituents. | `EQX EQX-NDX` | fundamental |  |
| `DIV` | Dividend curve | Expected dividends by year (implied from dividend futures and forwards). | `DIV DIV-CSCA` | fundamental |  |
| `EQV` | Equity volatility surface | Implied vols by expiry and moneyness. | `EQV EQV-CSCA` | fundamental |  |
| `CDS` | Credit curve | CDS par spreads by tenor, recovery and implied default probabilities. | `CDS CDS-SOLARIS` | fundamental |  |
| `INF` | Inflation index | Published CPI fixings (US CPI-U NSA, HICPxT, UK RPI…). | `INF INF-HICPX` | fundamental |  |

| `CMD` | Commodity | A traded commodity with its benchmark, unit and venue. | `CMD CMD-BRENT` | fundamental |  |

| `CMDV` | Commodity volatility surface | Implied vols by delivery month and moneyness. | `CMDV CMDV-BRENT` | fundamental |  |
| `FIX` | Rate index fixings | Published overnight and term rate fixings (SOFR, €STR, SONIA…). | `FIX FIX-AONIA` | fundamental |  |
| `BND` | Bond (security master) | A listed bond: terms, price, yield, spreads and analytics. | `BND BND-BRVERD054608` | fundamental |  |
| `CORR` | Correlation matrix | Pairwise correlations used by basket, quanto and spread products. | `CORR CORR-EU-EQ` | fundamental |  |

## Market risk (`market-risk`)

Value at risk, stress testing, FRTB sensitivities and P&L explain.

| Command | Opens | What it does | Example | Data | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SCN` | Stress scenario | A named historical or hypothetical shock set. | `SCN SCN-COVID2020` | fundamental |  |
| `STR` | Stress result | P&L of a desk under a scenario, by book. | `STR STR-GFC2008-RATES` | fundamental |  |
| `FRTB` | FRTB sensitivities | Delta, vega and curvature by risk class and bucket (SBM). | `FRTB FRTB-RATES-1` | fundamental |  |
| `PNL` | P&L explain | Daily P&L attributed to risk factors, new trades and residual. | `PNL PNL-RATES-1` | fundamental |  |
| `TVAL` | Trade valuation | A trade's valuation from the risk engine, for every source system: MTM, one-day P&L and DV01, with what it values (source system, portfolio, desk, product). | `TVAL TVAL-1000001` | fundamental |  |
| `POS` | Position | A position: one security held in one book (or one OTC trade), the trades that build or reduce it, and its VaR computed as the page opens. | `POS POS-BOOK-EQD-2~SEC-WARRANT-USD-01` | Drishti's own |  |
| `PORT` | Portfolio | A portfolio in terms of the positions inside it: longs and shorts, market value, VaR, ES and each position's contribution. | `PORT PF-RATES-DESK` | engine input |  |
| `PNLV` | P&L vector (509 scenarios) | P&L vector of a trade | `PNLV PV-MX-20000274-HS-509` | engine input |  |
| `SSET` | Scenario set | Scenario set | `SSET HS-509` | engine input |  |
| `HIER` | Risk hierarchy node | Risk hierarchy node | `HIER LEGAL~LE-NY` | engine input |  |
| `VRES` | VaR of a scope (computed) | The VaR, ES, decomposition, worst scenarios and P&L vector of any scope (the scope grammar of VAR_GUIDE.md section 5), computed when asked by the server's VaR engine as the person asking; never stored. | `VRES DESK:RATES` | computed |  |
| `VWIF` | VaR what-if (computed, Python) | A scope's VaR and ES before and after hypothetical trades kept in the person's private sandbox, and its stressed window, computed when asked by the Python VaR engine from the scope's var-result; never stored. |  | computed |  |

## News and markets (`news-and-markets`)

Sample pack: fifteen news topics (central banks, countries, companies, themes) and twenty listed companies, with headlines (Google News) and quotes and price history (Yahoo Finance) fetched on demand. Internal demonstration only: Yahoo's endpoint is unofficial and its terms restrict use; names leave the network when the connectors are on. Off until the connectors are enabled; offline (DRISHTI_OFFLINE=true, or the connectors off) the demo lake serves a captured snapshot of the same quotes and headlines.

| Command | Opens | What it does | Example | Data | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TOPIC` | News topic | A topic and the news about it: headlines (newest first) with their publishers and links, a count by source, and how the headlines were chosen. | `TOPIC TOPIC-FED` | fundamental |  |
| `NEWS` | Headlines | The headlines for one name, as the news connector computed them: newest first, filtered for relevance, duplicates removed. | `NEWS NEWS-Bitcoin` | fundamental |  |
| `CO` | Listed company | A listed company: its live quote and price history (yfinance connector) and its news headlines (news connector), both computed on demand. | `CO CO-AAPL` | fundamental |  |
| `QUOTE` | Quote and price history | A quote and recent price history for a ticker, as the yfinance connector computed them. | `QUOTE QUOTE-MSFT` | fundamental |  |

## Trading (`trading`)

Trades in 125 products across rates, FX, credit, equity, commodities, inflation, fixed income, securities financing, money markets and structured products.

| Command | Opens | What it does | Example | Data | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TRD` | Trade | Trade | `TRD MX-20000001` | fundamental |  |
| `CTRD` | Counterparty trades (derived from trades) | Every trade with a counterparty, from every source system: its trades (every status, a status filter), upcoming payments, notional by product type and index, maturities, payments by month. | `CTRD CP-ALDERSHOT` | computed |  |
| `PTRD` | Portfolio trades (derived from trades) | Every trade of a portfolio (book), from every source system: its trades (every status, a status filter), upcoming payments, notional by product type and index, maturities, payments by month. |  | computed |  |
| `LTRD` | Legal entity trades (derived from trades) | Every trade a legal entity of the bank booked, from every source system: its trades (every status, a status filter), upcoming payments, notional by product type and index, maturities, payments by month. |  | computed |  |
| `ITRD` | Index trades (derived from trades) | Every trade with a leg on an index (the first leg that names one): its trades (every status, a status filter), upcoming payments, notional by product type and index, maturities, payments by month. |  | computed |  |

## US equities (`us-equities`)

Public data on the companies of the Dow 30, the Nasdaq-100 and the S&P 500, and on major US, Canadian and UK banks that file with the SEC: SEC EDGAR companies, SIC sectors, filings and ten years of annual XBRL financials, LEIs from GLEIF and index membership from Wikidata. Prices are not shipped: the price-history kind is read live by a connector that is off by default and for internal use only.

| Command | Opens | What it does | Example | Data | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `USEQ` | US company | A US listed company: key facts, ten years of annual financials, recent SEC filings and index memberships, from public data. | `USEQ AAPL` | fundamental |  |
| `IDX` | Index members | An equity index's members (Dow 30, Nasdaq-100, S&P 500) as Wikidata records them; a click opens the member's summary beside. | `IDX SP500` | fundamental |  |
| `SIC` | SIC sector | A sector by its SIC code: its companies ranked by revenue; a click opens a company's summary beside. | `SIC 3674` | fundamental |  |
| `EDGAR` | EDGAR filings browser | The filings browser: the latest SEC filings of the covered companies, of every form or one; a click opens a filing beside. | `EDGAR 8-K` | fundamental |  |
| `FILING` | SEC filing | One SEC filing: its company, form, dates, 8-K items and its links on EDGAR (metadata only; the document stays on sec.gov). | `FILING 0001104659-26-117587` | fundamental |  |
| `FACT` | Financial fact | One financial concept of one company (revenue, net income, assets...) over up to ten fiscal years, from its 10-K XBRL filings. | `FACT AAPL-REVENUE` | fundamental |  |
| `PXH` | Price history (live, internal use only) | A company's quote and a year of daily prices, read live by the us-equities-prices connector: off as shipped, internal use only. |  | fundamental |  |

## World economy (`world-economy`)

Real public economic data for about 200 economies: output, growth, prices, jobs, debt and external balance (World Bank, IMF, CIA World Factbook), IMF forecasts, and World Bank regions and income groups; and governments and societies: government type, office holders, elections, parties with seats, and social and governance indicators (CIA World Factbook, World Bank, UNDP).

| Command | Opens | What it does | Example | Data | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ECON` | Economy | An economy: output, growth, prices, jobs, debt and external balance, and output by sector, from World Bank, IMF and CIA data. | `ECON ECON-IND` | fundamental |  |
| `MACRO` | Macro indicator | One headline statistic of one economy: the series, the latest value, the change and the rank among economies. | `MACRO MACRO-BRA-GDP-GROWTH` | fundamental |  |
| `FCST` | Economic forecast | The IMF World Economic Outlook: growth, inflation, unemployment, external balance and debt, outturn and projections to 2031. | `FCST FCST-JPN-WEO` | fundamental |  |
| `LABR` | Labour market | Unemployment, participation, youth and female labour, and employment and output by sector. | `LABR LABR-NGA` | fundamental |  |
| `FISC` | Fiscal position | Government debt and net lending (IMF) with revenue, expense and military spending (World Bank), as shares of GDP. | `FISC FISC-USA` | fundamental |  |
| `ECG` | Country group | A World Bank region or income group (or the world): output, population, growth and its largest economies. | `ECG ECG-SAS` | fundamental |  |
| `REGE` | Region economy | A state or territory (ISO 3166-2): population, GDP and GDP per head. | `REGE REGE-AU-NSW` | fundamental |  |
| `JUR` | Jurisdiction | A country: government type, capital, legislature and seats by party, office holders, elections and governance indicators, from the CIA World Factbook, World Bank and UNDP. | `JUR JUR-IND` | fundamental |  |
| `PARTY` | Party | A political party that won seats in the lower chamber at the most recent election, with the chamber's full result. | `PARTY PARTY-IND-01` | fundamental |  |
| `OFFC` | Office holder | The chief of state or head of government of a country as the CIA World Factbook publishes them, with how the office is filled. | `OFFC OFFC-JPN-HOG` | fundamental |  |
| `ELEC` | Election | The most recent election to a chamber or to the executive, with the system, term, seats by party and the date of the next one. | `ELEC ELEC-BRA-LOW` | fundamental |  |
| `REGN` | World region | A World Bank region: its countries, population, life expectancy, women in parliament, Internet use and the government types found in it. | `REGN REGN-SSF` | fundamental |  |
| `SOCI` | Social indicator | A social or governance statistic of one country over time, with the regional comparison: health, education, inequality, rights and rule of law. | `SOCI SOCI-NGA-WGI-LAW` | fundamental |  |
